name: Curios of Curiosity
summary: You carry a satchel of unusual mementos to Melanie Sable. Their fine craftsmanship may make them useful.

sections.title: A Satchel for Melanie
sections.body: Someone who examined the mementos sends you to Melanie Sable with the satchel. They believe the objects are safe, though their origin remains unknown. Their workmanship is unusual, and Melanie may find a use for them.

faq.q: Who should I take the mementos to?
faq.answer: Take the satchel of mementos to Melanie Sable, as the examiner asks.
They are remnants of something, but the examiner does not know exactly what.
Their craftsmanship is described as quite unique and intricate.
The examiner asks you to tell Melanie that the mementos are safe.

attribution: In-game quest text: Curios of Curiosity
